author: Sebastian Witt
name: rename-tags
description: Adds a lighttable entry to rename an existing tag by replacing it with a new name across all images (deprecated).
description-extensive: This add-on lets you rename a keyword tag: you type the old tag name and a new one, and it swaps them on every photo that used the old tag. It saves you from removing and re-adding tags one photo at a time. This script is marked as deprecated as of darktable 4.0, since the feature is now built in.
